effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
purpose: I run a small residential cleaning company and need a professional monthly service agreement for a homeowner client. It started as standard house cleaning twice a month, but now they keep adding laundry, organizing closets, pet cleanup, refrigerator deep cleans, and last-minute extra visits without confirming pricing first. I need something clean and easy to understand that clearly defines what regular monthly service includes, rates for extra work, cancellation notice requirements, lockout/no-access fees, payment due dates, late fees, supplies responsibility, damage reporting windows, pet safety expectations, photo permission for before/after results, and a respectful way for either side to pause or end the arrangement. The agreement should feel modern, fair, collaborative, and simple for both parties to review changes and sign online.
title: Agreement
